description:
Stop losing business cards. Stop forgetting to follow up. Cardr.AI turns every handshake into a fully enriched CRM contact in seconds.

You meet someone at a conference, grab their card or scan their badge, and by the time you're back at the booth, Cardr.AI has already found their verified email, LinkedIn profile, and company details. No typing, no guessing, no lost cards buried in your jacket pocket.

Scan anything. Point your camera at a business card, event badge, or LinkedIn QR code. Our OCR captures every field in under a second, and AI enrichment fills in the blanks you'd never have time to look up yourself.

Remember every conversation. Hit record during a meeting and get live transcription, an AI-generated summary, and clear action items. Weeks later, you'll still know exactly what you promised and to whom.

Run your network like a pipeline. Move leads through stages from New to Won, organize contacts by event, and set follow-up reminders so nobody falls through the cracks again.

Share yourself just as fast. Send your own digital business card by link, QR code, email, or NFC tap, no printing, no running out mid-conference.

Ask your network anything. Chat with an AI assistant that knows every contact, note, and follow-up across your entire pipeline, and export everything to CSV or vCard whenever you need it.

Founders, sales pros, and serial networkers use Cardr.AI to turn scattered business cards into a living, working CRM. Download Cardr.AI and never lose a lead again.

promotionalText: Scan a card, get a fully enriched contact in seconds. Voice meeting notes, AI summaries, and a sales pipeline built for networkers. Never lose a lead again.
